name: weibull-analysis
description: Fit and review Weibull analyses of component failure and suspension data: beta, eta, B10 life and confidence bounds, with survivors kept as suspensions and a clear not-estimable verdict when the data are too thin. Check Minitab, Weibull++, JMP or spreadsheet Weibull output for dropped survivors, flipped censor flags, mixed failure modes, swapped parameters and unsupported confidence claims. Test repair histories of repairable equipment for a rising failure rate before anyone fits Weibull to times between failures. Works from pasted or exported data; cites IEC 61649 and the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook.
